digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-1 finder and model selection
propositions: Pass-1 finder declared model_ladder rung 0 as 'trivial' (haiku) since workflow creation but silently inherited downgraded sonnet config because PydanticAIRunner.run discarded req.config until b690

Commit 4beec08a4 (2026-06-27) introduced _verifier_cfg to downgrade Pass-2/Pass-4 to sonnet, but accidentally applied downgrade to entire run; archaeology shows 115 opus plan-review runs before that date, zero after, proving regression not design

b690 made model_ladder declarations reachable for the first time; without it no ladder rung influences Pass-1 at all; with it the incorrect 'trivial' declaration now takes effect, deepening the regression

Pass-1 finder must run on frontier/opus (as it did pre-2026-06-27) to generate findings with intended strength; context-limit escalation fires spuriously when packing prerequisite bins against haiku's 200k instead of opus's 1M window

Downgrade is silent: haiku Pass-1 surfaces fewer grounded findings but still yields PASS verdict (gets signed), claim proceeds; sidecar records only verifier model never Pass-1's model, making change invisible in artifacts

Code-review Pass-1 correctly declares frontier while plan-review declares trivial despite both being blocking finders; asymmetry was never effective until b690 but must now be corrected to restore pre-2026-06-27 behavior
